deployment.method: Manifest-verified incremental files, isolated candidate preflight, original-file and database backups, restart with automatic file rollback on failure

findings: Cancelled older turns could hold the serialized memory worker for its 1.2-second identity-observation timeout, delaying later transcripts and memory tools. New speech now wakes that wait and persists the older turn without borrowing the new speaker identity.
Perception waited up to 800ms even when a short utterance had not started any voice inference. Such turns now take an immediate pending snapshot.

Production traces showed history search followed by history reads and repeated model rounds, taking about four seconds to first ROM progress. Search already returns up to 1000 characters of original text. Tool instructions now explicitly avoid rereading complete results and avoid redundant profile/perception queries.
Added bounded per-turn measurements for response creation, upstream first audio and ROM first playback progress; tool logs record name, duration and status, without arguments or transcript text.

isolated_memory_queue_reproduction.measurement: Local real-filesystem reproduction of a superseded context; this is one queue wait, not whole-conversation acoustic latency

real_agent_synthetic_speech.measurement: Upstream speech_stopped to first incoming audio; real configured Agent/ASR/TTS with an isolated device and simulated ROM, no microphone or acoustic measurement
real_agent_synthetic_speech.history_tool_calls: One chat_search in each sample; both answers correctly recalled the synthetic fact
real_agent_synthetic_speech.limits: Small samples show variability and do not establish a universal speedup; initial question audio was split into two endpointed segments. The final memory-queue fix is additionally covered by the targeted filesystem regression.
real_agent_synthetic_speech.fixtures: Synthetic devices and their data cleaned
